paragraphs.text: Glaciologists have traditionally measured glaciers by walking across them with GPS equipment, a slow and sometimes dangerous task. In the Swiss Alps, a team now uses small drones instead.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Each drone flight takes about 30 minutes and produces thousands of overlapping photographs. Software combines these images into a three-dimensional model accurate to within five centimetres.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: By comparing models made each autumn, the team can calculate how much ice has been lost. Between 2019 and 2023, one glacier they monitor became 12 metres thinner at its lowest point.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Drones cannot replace fieldwork entirely. Measuring the depth of the ice still requires radar equipment dragged across the surface, and strong winds often prevent the drones from flying at all. In winter, snow on the surface can also hide cracks in the ice.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: The team now plans to share its models online so that other researchers and local mountain guides can follow the changes from year to year.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: In the Swiss Alps, a team now uses small drones instead
items.prompt: In which mountain range does the team work?

explanation.en: “In the Swiss Alps, a team now uses small drones” → Swiss Alps (“the Alps” is also accepted).
explanation.kk: «In the Swiss Alps, a team now uses small drones» → Swiss Alps (the Alps да есептеледі).
explanation.ru: «In the Swiss Alps, a team now uses small drones» → Swiss Alps (засчитывается и the Alps).

items.quote: Each drone flight takes about 30 minutes
items.prompt: About how long does each drone flight last?

explanation.en: “Each drone flight takes about 30 minutes” → 30 minutes. “Five centimetres” in the next sentence is accuracy, not time.
explanation.kk: «Each drone flight takes about 30 minutes» → 30 minutes. Келесі сөйлемдегі «five centimetres» — уақыт емес, дәлдік.
explanation.ru: «Each drone flight takes about 30 minutes» → 30 minutes. «Five centimetres» в следующем предложении — точность, а не время.

items.quote: a three-dimensional model accurate to within five centimetres
items.prompt: To within what distance is the three-dimensional model accurate?

explanation.en: “accurate to within five centimetres” → five centimetres. The 12 metres in C is how much the glacier thinned.
explanation.kk: «accurate to within five centimetres» → five centimetres. C абзацындағы 12 metres — мұздықтың қаншалықты жұқарғаны.
explanation.ru: «accurate to within five centimetres» → five centimetres. 12 metres в абзаце C — насколько истончился ледник.

items.quote: By comparing models made each autumn
items.prompt: In which season are the models made?

explanation.en: “By comparing models made each autumn” → autumn. “Season” asks for a time of year, not 2019 or 2023.
explanation.kk: «By comparing models made each autumn» → autumn. «Season» — жыл мезгілі, сондықтан 2019 де, 2023 де емес.
explanation.ru: «By comparing models made each autumn» → autumn. «Season» — время года, поэтому не 2019 и не 2023.

items.quote: Measuring the depth of the ice still requires radar equipment
items.prompt: What equipment is still needed to measure the depth of the ice?

explanation.en: “Measuring the depth of the ice still requires radar equipment” → radar equipment. GPS in A was the old way of measuring the surface, not depth.
explanation.kk: «Measuring the depth of the ice still requires radar equipment» → radar equipment. A абзацындағы GPS — тереңдікті емес, бетті өлшеудің ескі тәсілі.
explanation.ru: «Measuring the depth of the ice still requires radar equipment» → radar equipment. GPS в абзаце A — старый способ измерять поверхность, а не глубину.
